ltv_slabs._note: Standard RBI three-slab. Boundaries <=30L, 30-75L, >75L, on property value. Confirmed on LIC HFL's own page (earlier synthesized source was mixed-tier; this is LIC-official).
ltv_slabs._source: LIC HFL official home loan page (lichousing.com)

retirement_age._source: Mixed synthesis (LIC blog + aggregators) - NOT a single LIC-official eligibility page. Internally inconsistent.
retirement_age._note: COMPLEX/UNCERTAIN. Standard salaried ~68 (retire + up to 10yrs post-retirement, max application age 50). Pensioners up to 70. With young co-applicant, tenure extends up to age 80. Sources conflicted (some said 60, some 68/70) and were mostly aggregators - NOT confirmed from single LIC HFL eligibility page. Verify on LIC HFL official page or DSA.

min_cibil._source: LIC HFL official rate card (lichousing.com) - prices CIBIL down to 201-599 and 101-200
min_cibil._note: NO hard CIBIL floor. Rate card explicitly prices CIBIL 201-599 (9.70-10.15%) and even 101-200 bands - LIC HFL LENDS to very poor CIBIL, rate-loads rather than declines. But ceiling ~10% (conservative HFC), unlike Bajaj's 20%. 825+ gets best 7.15%. Most CIBIL-inclusive of the six alongside Bajaj, but caps rate far lower than Bajaj.

processing_fee._note: whichever is HIGHER (floor, not cap); plus applicable taxes. NRI/Value Plus/Reach schemes differ - not modeled yet. Other charges (legal, admin, valuation, prepayment) exist - deferred to full fee-schedule layer.

rate_band._note: Full CIBIL x loan-slab matrix, both salaried and self-employed. Self-employed ~15-20bps premium over salaried per band. PRIME 7.15% salaried / 7.30% SE = LOWEST of all six. Lends down to CIBIL 201-599 (~10%) but ceiling ~10%, NOT Bajaj's 20% - conservative HFC. Rate rises as CIBIL drops / loan grows. Anomaly: CIBIL 150-200/101-149 rows priced lower (~7.8-8.4%), likely new-to-credit category.
rate_band._source: LIC HFL official home loan rate card (lichousing.com)

foir_by_income_band._note: FOIR cap varies by income - proprietary, DSA-gated

accepted_income_proofs._note: LIC HFL keeps docs lean/standard. Self-employed 3 years ITR (like SBI, heavier than HDFC/ICICI/Axis's 2). Bank statement 6-12 months. Does not split self-employed prof/non-prof on its page (kept uniform here for schema).

co_applicant_clubbing._note: Key remediation lever for FOIR-bound buyers. Clubbing spouse/parent income raises FOIR base. Haircut % and allowed relationships are lender-specific - DSA-gated. Co-applicant's own EMIs usually also clubbed.
